evidence.title: Typescale - Create stunning typography, generate CSS, and find inspiration.

name: Typescale
summary: Web app for building responsive type scales and generating the CSS, with boards to save, explore and like.
description: Browser tool for typographic scales: set base font size, scale ratio and min-width, choose fonts, weights, line-height, letter-spacing and colors, and generate the matching CSS. Boards can be created, explored, bookmarked and liked, with an account via sign-up for saving them.
contains: body styles: font, weight, line-height, letter-spacing, color, background
